Pick your cat. Tap once for you, tap again to hand it to the CPU. Land hits to fill the special meter, then press SPEC.

PPUNCH
KKICK
SSPECIAL
A/D move · S crouch (ducks high kicks) · W jump · J punch · K kick (also in the air) · L special when the meter is full · Enter start · On touch screens: drag the stick, push up to jump
